children: Marriott Vacations Worldwide reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $1.367 billion, up 8.2% from a year earlier, and net income attributable to common stockholders of $82 million, compared with a $2 million loss in the prior-year quarter. Diluted EPS was $2.24, versus a loss of $0.07.
Revenue was $1.367B, compared with $1.263B in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 8.2%.
Net income attributable to common stockholders was $82M, compared with a $2M loss in the prior-year quarter.
Diluted EPS was $2.24, compared with a loss of $0.07 in the prior-year quarter.
Vacation Ownership sales increased 28%. Contract sales rose 29% and VPG increased 30%, while Tours declined 2%; owner contract sales grew 54%.
Existing-owner purchases strengthened, while contract sales to first-time buyers fell 20%. Tours outside Asia-Pacific increased 3%.
The company launched enhanced Owner Benefit Levels and its Inner Circle experiences platform, reporting favorable early event participation.
Marriott Vacations Worldwide expects sales growth to continue at a slower pace into 2027 and plans to retain certain assets to support future inventory needs.
